title: Scalar curvature on Kähler blow-ups and systolic inequalities
summary: In this paper, we develop the weighted level set method for a Kähler manifold $(X^n,ω)$ admitting an almost holomorphic map to a possibly singular base $Z$, which is not uniruled. As a key intermediate result, we prove that any blowup $\operatorname{Bl}_SX$ of $X$ along smooth submanifolds $S$ of $ \operatorname{codim} S\ge2$ admits a sequence of Kähler metrics with scalar curvature globally and arbitrarily $C^0$-close to the scalar curvature of $ω$.
